claim.scope_statement: There is a terminating exact decision procedure for q(x_1,...,x_n)=1 for every homogeneous quadratic form over Q, in arbitrary dimension and including degenerate forms. It returns a rational witness or a real/p-adic obstruction. This does not decide arbitrary polynomial equations over Q.
